description: Debbie's Dog Grooming in Del Rio offers comprehensive grooming services including baths, nail trimming, ear cleaning, and anal gland expression, with attention to coat type and skin condition. The salon caters to all breeds and includes health monitoring during grooming—checking for lumps, parasites, and skin issues—along with wheelchair-accessible facilities and multiple payment options. Services are designed for dogs of all ages, from puppies to seniors, with staff providing personalized care and at-home maintenance tips to extend grooming results between visits.
